question: Does a DURABLE, committed, unit-tested parameter-induction capability in the shipped kernel let a mechanism distilled from observations of resource A resolve, bind, execute and verify correctly on never-observed resource B whose identifier value set is disjoint from A, and does that mechanism then reach amortized_cost_ratio at or below 0.85 against B-COLD, B-LITERAL-REPLAY and B-RETRIEVAL-K5 at matched end-to-end success?
hypothesis: A corrected parameter-induction pipeline (distill_parameterized + align_parameters + _build_action_template preserving URL prefix + _strip_common_prefix called) implemented in src/spider/kernel.py at HEAD, with tests reaching EXECUTABLE through distill(), will produce mechanisms that transfer to never-observed resource-B identifiers at success_rate >= 0.95, and the amortized cost ratio against executed baselines will be <= 0.85 with break-even at or before N_MAX derived from measured B-COLD per-task cost.
falsifier: The hypothesis is FALSIFIED if ANY of: (1) PC-SAME-RESOURCE success_rate < 0.95 on bound paths of form /api/v1/<collection>/<slot>; (2) amortized_cost_ratio > 0.85 against ANY of B-COLD, B-LITERAL-REPLAY, B-RETRIEVAL-K5 at matched end-to-end success; (3) break_even_transfer_tasks > N_MAX where N_MAX is derived before freeze from executed B-COLD cost; (4) NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT transfer_success > 0.10; (5) positive control or null control fails; (6) n < 50 per family or family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap not computed; (7) < 60 negative probes per arm executed.

B-COLD.description: Cold discovery executed per task: multi-step auth, pagination traversal, and schema discovery actually performed and counted per task on resource-B endpoints. Cost measured in HTTP requests.

B-LITERAL-REPLAY.description: Literal mechanism replay: exact action_template from resource-A observation replayed on resource-B without parameter binding. Expected to fail on identifier mismatch.

B-RETRIEVAL-K5.description: Semantic retrieval baseline: top-5 nearest observations from resource-A by intent+state embedding similarity, executed literally on resource-B.

positive_control.description: Mechanism induced from resource-A observations, resolved and executed on SAME resource-A identifiers (disjoint value set from training but same endpoint structure). Tests that the induction+resolution pipeline works when URL prefix is preserved and intent namespace matches.

null_control.description: Mechanism induced from resource-A observations with intent labels randomly permuted across observations. Evaluated on transfer_success criterion (not induced-mechanism count). Should fail to transfer because intent structure is destroyed.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: No predictor contains the target directly. Intent labels used for induction are from training observations only. Resource-B test identifiers are disjoint from resource-A training identifiers. B-COLD cost is measured by actual execution, not configured.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: Training observations (resource-A) and test observations (resource-B) are disjoint by construction. Substrate server state is reset between arms. No site/task identity leaks into features.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: Deterministic seeds for substrate, observation collection, and bootstrap. Resource-B identifier sets are fixed before freeze. Family stratification preserved in bootstrap.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap for all ratio metrics. Resampling unit is task family. Correlated transitions within family are not treated as independent.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: Raw HTTP request/response preserved. Induced mechanism fields (parameter_slots, action_template with preserved prefix) have operational meaning. Cost counted as actual HTTP requests executed.

conditions: Treatment.break_even_transfer_tasks <= N_MAX (derived before freeze from executed B-COLD cost)
Treatment.success_rate >= 0.95 on resource-B at matched end-to-end success with baselines
n >= 50 per family for ALL arms (PC-SAME-RESOURCE, NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT, Treatment, B-COLD, B-LITERAL-REPLAY, B-RETRIEVAL-K5)
Family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap computed for amortized_cost_ratio and break_even_transfer_tasks
60 negative probes per arm executed for abstention/false-accept measurement

product_consequence_positive: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances to VALIDATED. Durable parameter-induction capability exists in shipped kernel with demonstrated cross-resource transfer and amortized economics. Enables C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE experiments with executable mechanisms. Product promotion gate becomes decidable.
product_consequence_negative: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL or moves to REJECTED if falsifier triggered by mechanism failure (not measurement failure). The add-at-execute/delete-at-verdict pathology continues. Product lane must either fix kernel defects at deeper level or accept that parameter induction is not viable on this architecture. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON remain unmeasurable without executable inheritance.

estimated_cost.compute: stdlib HTTP only, no browser, no model keys

expected_information_gain: High. This is the binding bottleneck for the entire product program. A valid positive makes inheritance executable and measurable; a valid negative (with measurement validity) forces architectural reconsideration. Either outcome changes the program direction decisively.
